stories.title: Flintshire Foodbank warns warehouse is “never been so empty”
stories.summary: Flintshire Foodbank has issued an urgent appeal, saying its warehouse has never been so empty. The charity said: “We’re very worried. stories.title: Overnight social media curfews for teenagers to become law from 2027
stories.summary: Social media platforms will be required to switch off access for 16 and 17 year olds overnight by default under new UK government regulations. stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS Ken Skates named Welsh Labour leader
stories.summary: Ken Skates MS has been confirmed as permanent leader of Welsh Labour. He received unanimous backing from all nine members of the Senedd Labour group. Skates represents Fflint Wrecsam, the Senedd constituency covering Flintshire and Wrexham. He became interim leader of Welsh Labour in May, after Eluned Morgan resigned. stories.title: Welsh Government loses first budget vote in Senedd defeat
stories.summary: The Welsh Government’s first supplementary budget has failed to pass in the Senedd, after a dispute over funding for additional learning needs left Plaid Cymru without the cross-party support it needed.
